item.description:
AgentDock 1.0: now $19, after a 7-day free trial.

  • Try everything for 7 days. After the trial, the status dots and the hover card keep working for free. Answering from the Inbox, ⌥⌥ messages and answering from your iPhone need a license.
  • $19 once (plus tax where it applies), for up to 3 Macs. Buy it from the menu or Settings › License. After paying, your browser brings you straight back to AgentDock with the key filled in.
  • Lost your key? agentdockapp.com/activate finds it again from your email and the card you paid with.
  • Settings › License shows your trial, your license, and frees a Mac when you move to a new one.
  • The iPhone page says when answering is locked, instead of quietly doing nothing.
  • Fixed: two copies of AgentDock running at once (say, a test build) could cut each other off from Claude Code's hook.

Thank you for trying AgentDock early.

Logos where they help, and updates that show up right away.

  • Provider icons now stay on the folded strip. The hover card, the Inbox and ⌥⌥ go back to plain status dots, since their rows already start with each agent's logo.
  • New versions are offered as soon as they're out. AgentDock used to be handed a cached copy of the update feed for a few minutes after a release, so "Check for Updates" could miss it.

See which provider each agent is.

  • Provider icons: turn on Settings › Appearance › Provider icons and every dot shows its agent's logo (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok; a square for other agents), on the strip, the hover card, the Inbox and ⌥⌥. The color still says what the agent is doing, and agents that need you keep their halo.
  • The hover card's marks are now the providers' logos, so a dot on the strip and its row look alike.
  • The Settings preview shows the folded strip beside the hover card.
